mapper.insert: insert into OwnerRequests (user_id, salon_name, salon_phone, message, request_type) values (#{userId}, #{salonName}, #{salonPhone}, #{message}, #{requestType, jdbcType=VARCHAR, javaType=String})
mapper.select: select request_id, user_id, salon_name, salon_phone, message, request_type, status, requested_at, processed_at, processed_by from OwnerRequests where request_id = #{requestId}
select count(*) from OwnerRequests where status = 'pending'
